title: Public reporting instructions and private vulnerability intake need an exercised handoff
remediation: Product security and deployment intake owners verify the published instructions reach the approved private channel. Exercise a clearly marked benign report through receipt, triage and owner handoff, retaining restricted and redacted evidence. Record how deployed services receive reports or inherit the approved organizational route.
